judged_text: apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:49 — `if (multiEmailValue.length === 0)` never matches the initial `[""]` state, so clicking Add with an empty field fails `z.string().email()` and shows "Emails must be unique and valid" instead of doing nothing, and `isInvalidEmail` is never cleared after a successful add or edit, so the stale error persists when the dialog is reopened (P3, conf 75)

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `multiEmailValue` is initialized as `[""]`, so `if (multiEmailValue.length === 0)` in `handleAdd` will not short-circuit for an empty input; it will run zod validation, fail `z.string().email()` on the empty string, and set `isInvalidEmail` true (showing the error) when the user effectively submitted “no emails”. Also, on success the mutation handler resets `multiEmailValue` and closes the dialog but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`, so the error state can persist when the dialog is reopened because the component remains mounted and `isInvalidEmail` stays true.
